men.summary: The Bluejays sit at 3-1 with a two-game win streak, highlighted by a 70-69 squeaker over Iowa for their 1-0 Quadrant 1 mark, though their lone loss was an 89-82 setback at Kansas State. With a NET of 83 (despite a stronger RPI of 34) and Big East play still ahead at 0-0, their NCAA tournament outlook is open but unproven, as they'll need a strong conference showing to climb into at-large range.

women.summary: At 3-1 with a perfect 3-0 road record, the Bluejays have opened strongly, highlighted by a 73-71 win at South Dakota State (their 1-0 Quadrant 1 mark) and a 72-50 win at Northern Iowa, with the only loss a 54-49 neutral-site defeat to South Dakota. A NET ranking of 91 and an RPI of 196 leave them outside at-large range for now, so with Big East play still ahead (0-0), they will need a strong conference record and more quality wins to make the NCAA Tournament, with the WBIT a more realistic target if they stay at this level.
